paragraphs: Issi ben Gur Aryeh: see the entry R' Asi (I).[^1]

notes.text: The source pointer abbreviates Asi's title, retained as R', and א) marks the first same-name entry(I). The root had inferred Rav from a companion full-title numbered pointer; that lexical inference remains in history rather than becoming an explicit title in this occurrence. The old note1/item(a) parsing is superseded without inventing missing note text or binding identity. The companion text is a preserved earlier review claim, not a newly inspected whole witness in this release.
